answer: In an agent marketplace, services such as falcon, lotus and zenith vote on upgrades with weight proportional to tokens locked in escrow for 30 days. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake agents still yields only 100 tokens of voting weight, because each token can back only one deposit. To control a majority, an attacker must acquire and lock more tokens than honest voters combined, tying up capital and bearing price risk throughout the lock.
